ui.hub.teams.recency.updated.role: Recency segment in an organization team row's provenance line
ui.hub.teams.recency.updated.tone: Quiet, lowercase fragment; it follows the project and author segments after a dot.
ui.hub.teams.recency.updated.length_hint: Two words plus the age in English. The row's provenance line is a single truncated line, so keep the surrounding words short.

placeholders.when: The localized relative phrase produced by the hub's shared age messages (ui.hub.comments.age.*), for example '2 days ago' or 'just now'. It already contains its own 'ago'; translate only the verb around it.

ui.hub.teams.recency.updated.note: ONE whole sentence, so the target language can put the time before the verb. It is used when updated_at supplied the date; the created sibling is used only when updated_at is missing or unparseable, and the two must stay distinguishable. Never put 'updated' over a creation date.

ui.hub.teams.recency.created.role: Recency segment when only the team's creation date is usable
ui.hub.teams.recency.created.tone: Quiet, lowercase fragment, sibling of recency.updated.
ui.hub.teams.recency.created.length_hint: Same single truncated line as recency.updated.

placeholders.when: The same localized relative phrase as recency.updated carries.

ui.hub.teams.recency.created.note: The fallback arm: it must say the date is the creation date, not claim the team was updated. Keep it parallel to recency.updated so only the verb differs.
